summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Indian PII Redaction Tool's new download architecture (Iteration 3). Major architectural change from client-side blob URLs to server-side file storage with hidden iframe downloads fully implemented and tested. All new endpoints working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend API health check (200 OK with correct message)
New file_id response format from POST /api/redact (32-char hex IDs)
GET /api/download/{file_id} with proper Content-Disposition attachment headers
GET /api/audit-csv/{file_id} with CSV content and attachment headers
POST /api/audit-csv-batch for multiple files with proper CSV structure
File TTL system (10-minute expiry) returns 404 for expired/invalid file_ids
Single .docx file upload and download via hidden iframe (20 PII items)
Legacy .doc file support with backend conversion to .docx format (4 PII items)
Batch multi-file upload processing (28 total PII items across 2 files)
Per-file results display with individual download buttons for batch uploads
Download All Redacted button with staggered iframe downloads
Export Audit Report CSV functionality for single files
Export Audit Report CSV functionality for batch files
Start Over button resets application to upload state
Page stays on results after downloads (no navigation away from results)
All buttons remain clickable and enabled after download actions
Frontend successfully uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for all API calls
Hidden iframe download mechanism bypasses popup blockers
Toast notifications show correct processing status and PII counts
UI displays combined stats grid for batch uploads
File input accepts both .doc and .docx with multiple file selection

success_percentage.backend: 100% (11/11 tests passed - all new download endpoints working)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all UI flows with iframe downloads tested successfully)
